summary: The Forgotten Realms Dungeons & Dragons RPG series spanning BioWare's Infinity Engine classics, console action-RPG spin-offs, Beamdog Enhanced Editions, and Larian's modern sequel.

entries.title: Baldur's Gate
entries.definitive_edition: Baldur's Gate: Enhanced Edition on Windows

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output with high-resolution/widescreen support.

primary.version: Baldur's Gate: Enhanced Edition PC release
primary.why: The Enhanced Edition includes the original game and Tales of the Sword Coast expansion, adds widescreen/high-resolution support, quality-of-life features, and new content, while Windows is the most configurable archive route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Baldur's Gate: Enhanced Edition on Windows with current Beamdog patches; use original PC only for historical comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original purists may prefer the 1998 release with community mods, but no exclusive story route is required because the Enhanced Edition includes Tales of the Sword Coast.

entries.title: Baldur's Gate II: Shadows of Amn
entries.definitive_edition: Baldur's Gate II: Enhanced Edition on Windows

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output with high-resolution/widescreen support.

primary.version: Baldur's Gate II: Enhanced Edition PC release
primary.why: The Enhanced Edition includes Shadows of Amn and the Throne of Bhaal expansion, adds widescreen/high-resolution support and new content, and Windows is the best modern archive route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Baldur's Gate II: Enhanced Edition on Windows with current patches; use the original Complete release only for historical comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original purists may prefer older builds with community mods, but the Enhanced Edition includes Throne of Bhaal and no separate exclusive route is required.

entries.title: Baldur's Gate: Dark Alliance

emulation.notes: Use the native PC re-release; original PS2/GameCube/Xbox emulation is optional for comparison.

primary.why: The modern PC re-release supports higher-resolution output and is the most practical high-fidelity archive route for the console action-RPG spin-off. Original console and handheld versions are historical routes without unique story content documented as required.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows re-release through Steam/GOG with current patches; use original PS2/Xbox/GameCube hardware or emulation only for historical comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: The modern release is a reissue rather than a remake; original-console emulation remains useful for historical feel.

entries.title: Baldur's Gate: Dark Alliance II

emulation.notes: Use the native PC re-release; PS2/Xbox emulation is optional for comparison.

primary.version: Baldur's Gate: Dark Alliance II PC re-release
primary.why: The 2022 PC re-release brings the formerly PS2/Xbox-only sequel to modern platforms, making Windows the highest-fidelity and cleanest archive route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows re-release through Steam/GOG with current patches; use PS2/Xbox hardware or emulation only for historical comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: The modern release is a reissue rather than a remake; original-console emulation remains useful for historical feel.

entries.title: Baldur's Gate: Siege of Dragonspear

primary.version: Baldur's Gate: Siege of Dragonspear PC release
primary.why: This Beamdog expansion/interquel is original Baldur's Gate content and runs best as part of the Enhanced Edition PC ecosystem. Windows is the most configurable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Siege of Dragonspear on Windows after Baldur's Gate: Enhanced Edition and before Baldur's Gate II: Enhanced Edition.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is an expansion/interquel for Baldur's Gate: Enhanced Edition, not a replacement for the base game.

entries.title: Baldur's Gate 3

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with current patches.

primary.version: Baldur's Gate 3 PC release with current patches
primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity and most configurable route for Larian's sequel, with the broadest mod/capture options. Console, Mac, Linux, and cloud routes do not add exclusive story content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows build through Steam or GOG with the latest patches; use the Digital Deluxe/physical Deluxe only for extras, not required gameplay content.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or expansion route is required; revisit only if a later complete edition changes gameplay content.
